summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, including the transaction price effective June 1, 2026, and valuation methodology overseen by its board and independent valuation advisor Altus Group. The filing provides a table of NAV components but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or activist campaign. It is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation event.
